reference: The Project Studio preview of the GridKrafter dashboard (a port of GridKrafter.Demo.Mvc)

regions.name: Board
regions.describes: The GridKrafter board: section tabs (Overview, Sales, +), Edit layout and Add widget buttons, and a 12-column grid of draggable, resizable, collapsible, recolourable widgets with headers (icon, title, refresh/fullscreen/collapse/delete buttons), saved after each change
regions.why: KanbanBoard moves records between status lanes; this is a free 2-D grid layout of resizable widgets (x, y, w, h on 12 columns, collision and compaction from GridKrafter.Core) hosting arbitrary Wisej controls, with sections, collapse, fullscreen and recolour, which KanbanBoard cannot show

regions.name: Stat tiles
regions.describes: Revenue, Visitors, Orders, Uptime: label, big value, trend vs last week, sparkline, coloured accent stripe

regions.name: Activity widget body
regions.describes: Newest-first feed: coloured icon, text, relative time

regions.name: Server load widget body
regions.describes: CPU, Memory, Disk, Network: name, percentage and a coloured bar

regions.name: Recent orders widget body
regions.describes: Order #, Customer, Placed, Status badge, Total

regions.name: Text widgets
regions.describes: How this page works, Note, Links: short text and links
